decisions.reason: Adding door-offset and bathroom-width annotations does not change the Unit 3 door position or its kitchen-counter clearance constraint.
The source requests documentation of the existing Unit 3 bathroom width; it does not change the bathroom dimensions, fixtures, drain, or shower layout.
Bathroom dimension annotations do not alter the Unit 3 kitchen arrangement or its existing bathroom-door clearance constraint.
Annotating bathroom-door wall offsets does not resolve or change the Unit 1 ensuite fixture-fit conflict or any confirmed layout value.
The requested door-offset annotations document the plan without changing the Unit 2 bathroom door's centered position.
Bathroom dimension annotations do not change the content or separation of the furnished-layout drawing.
The later request for specific dimension annotations does not modify the content or purpose of the initial concept sketch.
This candidate's same-message door-type change is independently supported by a separate clause; the source annotation changes do not alter or augment that door-type requirement.
Door-offset and bathroom-width annotations do not change any drainage location, connection target, or existing-drain constraint.
The annotation request does not add, remove, or reposition any partition wall.
Documenting bathroom-door offsets does not change the Unit 1 common bathroom's fixtures, completion, or relationship to the ensuite.
The requested bathroom dimension annotations do not change the corridor-width issue or its wall-shift solution.
